risks.title: Medicaid Reduction
risks.score_rationale: The company receives significant revenues from Medicaid (approximately 100 million dollars or more from each large state). Legislation from July 4, 2025 (One Big Beautiful Bill Act) limits Medicaid enrollment and spending. The language in the report indicates significant exposure to potential Medicaid reductions.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Inflation could increase the company's costs, particularly labor costs, and reduce profit margins. The report indicates that inflation has already impacted the company's costs.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks could have a significant impact on the company, including data loss and reputational damage. United Kingdom operations are subject to strict data protection regulations (UK GDPR).

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the healthcare sector could impact the company's operating results. The report indicates that the company is exposed to competition from other healthcare providers.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes could have a significant impact on the company's operating results. The company is exposed to significant regulatory risks, including anti-corruption laws (FCPA, UK Bribery Act) and clinical standards.

risks.title: Debt
risks.score_rationale: The company's debt could impact operating results, particularly in terms of interest costs. The report indicates that the company carries significant debt and that interest rates could increase.
